messages.subject: Shiny app - graph hide/show issue-shiny javascript
parts:
If I click hide and leave the tab, go back to the tab and press show then graph doesn’t update as I alter the value in the numeric input box. I can still hide and show the graph though. I can also see that the graph does indeed change on the server side – it is simply the process of displaying that graph on the client side which is broken.

ui.r

library(shinydashboard)
library(xts)
library(dygraphs)

ui <- dashboardPage(
  dashboardHeader(title = "Basic dashboard"),
  dashboardSidebar(
    sidebarMenu(
      menuItem("Dashboard", tabName = "dashboard", icon = icon("dashboard")),
      menuItem("Widgets", tabName = "widgets", icon = icon("th"))
    )
  ),
  dashboardBody(
    tabItems(
      # First tab content
      tabItem(tabName = "dashboard",

              tags$ul(
                tags$li("Alter value in Volume input box and the graph will change"), 
                tags$li("Press hide"),
                tags$li("Go to 'Widgets' tab"), 
                tags$li("Go back to 'Dashboard' tab"),
                tags$li("Press show"), 
                tags$li("Two problems: a) You have to move the browser window slightly for the graph to display, b) the graph no longer changes as you alter the value in Volume input box.")
              ),

              htmlTemplate("test.html", name = "test"),
              tags$script(src = "test.js"),

              fluidRow(id = "id_row_graphs",
                       box(width = 12,
                           div(id = "div_graphs", style = "background-color:white",
                               dygraphOutput("dy_plot", height = "310px")
                           )

                       ) # end of fluidRow
              )
      ),


      # Second tab content
      tabItem(tabName = "widgets",
              h2("Widgets tab content")
      )
    )
  )
)

server.r

server <- function(input, output) {

  observe({

    volume <- input$volume

    if(!is.null(volume)){

      dt_time <- seq(as.POSIXct("2017-01-01 00:00:00", tz = "GMT"), as.POSIXct("2017-01-02 00:00:00", tz = "GMT"), 1800)
      dd_value <- rep(as.numeric(volume), length(dt_time))
      ts_plot <- xts(dd_value, order.by = dt_time)
      dy_plot <- dygraph(ts_plot)

     output$dy_plot <- renderDygraph({ dy_plot })

    }

  })
}
